invariants.rationale: Both return paths in the method return a non-null Iterator.
fileId is used as an argument and for logging without null checks, so it is likely assumed non-null.
partitionPath is used as a parameter to other methods and constructors, so it is most likely non-null.
recordItr is passed as a non-null parameter and dereferenced in called constructors.
Both return paths yield Iterators with at least one element, so hasNext() should be true.
